expected: A TopicEditorViewModel built from a topic with hourly_rate 12550 USD has rate == "125.50" and validate() gives hourlyRateAmount == 12550 with currency == "USD", both untouched and with rate set to " 125.50 " (D-19)
actual: rate seeds as "125" (integer division by 100 drops the cents); the untouched validate() returns 12500 in "CAD" (re-parsed from the lossy seed and priced in defaultCurrency); with " 125.50 " validate() returns nil (decimal text fails the whole-number parser)
note: RED commit carries TopicEditorViewModel.editableAmount(minorUnits:currency:) as a compile-only stub that mirrors today's lossy String(minorUnits / 100) seed, so the rows compile and fail on their assertions rather than as a build failure. EarningsTransactionRow.formatMinorUnits was already internal.
semanticAssessment: The target test executed and failed on the planned D-19 assertions: rate seeded "125" not "125.50", the untouched save produced 12500 in "CAD" instead of 12550 in "USD", and the " 125.50 " text produced nil. The other five failing tests fail on their planned assertions too: editableAmount returns the lossy integer seed ("12" for 1250 USD, "12" for 1200 JPY, "125" for 12550 usd), EarningsTransactionRow.formatMinorUnits returns device-locale text ("JP¥1,200", "US$12.50"), the whole-dollar 12500 USD topic is re-priced in "CAD", and the two price-only topics seed "125" and save 12500. No build, load or fixture failure. The seven passing tests are guards (Task 1 and Task 2 rows, typed whole number in defaultCurrency, typed decimal rejected, new topic seeds empty and parses 150) that must keep passing after GREEN.
